name: Pomme - Autonomous Agricultural Automation Robot w/LiDAR and CV
description: Hack The 6ix Winner. Built an autonomous rover+robotic arm robot that uses SLAM and computer vision to autonomous navigate and pikc up fruits, automating a largely hand-done process.
bulletPoints: Designed a 3D-printed, 400mm, 4-DOF robotic arm capable of holding fruits 3-70mm in diameter, and up to 500g, for <$100
Implemented seamless, low latency communication between a Raspberry Pi 5 (Ubuntu), and an Arduino Uno Q (Debian), using a Flask server in under 36 hours
Designed and manufactured a custom rover, 100cm in length, 50cm in width, capable of carrying up to 10kg for under $150
Designed to successfully run autonomously using 2D LiDAR+SLAM and computer vision (yolo) running in parallel

name: sEMG Bionic Arm
description: Gold + Best Engineering @ Windsor Science Fair. Designed and manufactured a novel bionic arm using a custrom control mechanism that utilizes bicep and tricep electromyographic sensors and custom signal processing algorithms.
bulletPoints: Designed a modular CAD design in Fusion 360 via joints and master sketch techniques for modularity and easy iteration
Engineered a custom tendon-driven finger actuation system, fabricated via FDM 3D-printing for precise finger movement
Implemented and assisted in programming a Raspberry Pi Pico MCU for device control
Designed and soldered a custom 20A PCB, implementing sEMG control, 5DOF via servos, and easy peripheral access

name: GCI-Gauntlet: Assistance Device for Patients with Dementia Using Computer Vision and TTS
description: MasseyHacks 2nd Place. Designed a device that uses TTS w/ a Raspberry Pi to scan and identify faces with CV, and speak their name on a Bluetooth speaker.
bulletPoints: Built a wearable gauntlet with face recognition and TTS capabilities to assist users with dementia
Designed and 3D-printed a custom chassis and integrated embedded electronics with PWM control for seamless interaction
Incorporated distance sensing via ultrasonic sensors, and distance-based haptic feedback
Developed a Flask-based web app for live visual feedback, incorporating a server and database
Designed and Implemented a custom system where the gauntlet could be pointed at a user, and their name is spoken on a bluetooth speaker using TTS

name: Monoprop PCBs
description: Designed numerous PCB's to handle avionics of Monoprop superdrone for Georgia Tech's Propulsive Landers Team
bulletPoints: Designed multiple PCB's in KiCAD and Altium to sustain high temperature and pressures for a superdrone system
Incorporated 4 PCB layers (2x signal, power, ground) for power distribution without shorts and overheating
Designed to handle over 12V, with multiple signal lines to support low voltage peripherals and different protocols (I2C, UART, SPI)

name: Novel Soft Robotic Gripper (Publication Submission Pending)
description: Publication in progress. Designed and manufactured a novel soft robotic agricultural fruit gripper in association with the University of Windsor using kerf-bending techniques
bulletPoints: Used Fusion 360 CAD and FDM 3D-printed over 20 design iterations, improving on each through preliminary tests
Created a custom algorithm in Python to calculate maximum gripper deflection and modularize the gripper design process
Successfully tested and proved the functionality and repeatibility of the gripper with over 250 testing trials
Designed custom silicone molds via FDM 3D-printing, successfully limiting fruit damage and load-sliping to a minimum
Used a custom cycloidal negative-space geometry to successfully grip on fruits with diameters ranging from 30mm-140mm

name: Computer Vision Street Fighter
description: 105% in Grade 12 CS. Built a Street Fighter in Java and Python that uses a custom trained Tensorflow RNN to classify body movements and translate them into moves
bulletPoints: Used Mediapipe and Tensorflow to train an RNN to successfully classify hand gestures and body movements at over 85% accuracy for gameplay translation
Incorporated a custom data-localization algorithm to treat mediapipe data the same no matter the distance from the camera or rotation
Used Java to program gameplay including animations, over 6 attack moves, and custom moves for each character for fun playability
Implemented a local Flask server and two Python instances that communicate to allow for multi-player fighting

name: Exhaust Thermoelectric Generator
description: National Bronze Medal @ Canada Wide Science Fair. Built a novel thermoelectric generator that uses the Peltier effect to generate electricty from exhaust waste heat
bulletPoints: Designed, manufactured, and tested a novel device that was successfully proved to generate electricity from exhaust waste heat
Utilized Autodesk CFD and custom computational fluid dynamics simulations to simulate various geometries' impact on exhaust backpressure, minimizing the device's effects on engine performance
Used sheet metal bending and custom 3d-printed molds to make complex geometries which sustain high temperatures
Performed various statistical analysis including an Anova test to prove minimal statistical variance
